career.label: Career & Work
career.intro: Career themes are read mainly from the 10th house (profession), supported by the 6th (daily work), 2nd (income skills), and 11th (gains).

marriage.label: Marriage & Partnership
marriage.intro: Marriage and partnership lean on the 7th house and Venus (and Jupiter for traditional blessings), with 2nd/8th/11th adding family and shared-life context.

love.label: Love & Romance
love.intro: Romance and attraction are shown by the 5th house (heart), Venus, and how Mars/Moon color desire and feelings.

health.label: Health & Vitality
health.intro: Health is judged from Lagna (vitality), 6th (ailments/routine), and 8th (chronic or sudden issues), plus luminaries and Mars/Saturn.

money.label: Money & Wealth
money.intro: Wealth themes come from the 2nd (accumulated resources) and 11th (gains), with 5th/9th showing speculative and fortune support.

education.label: Education & Learning
education.intro: Learning is seen from Mercury (intellect), Jupiter (wisdom), 4th/5th (formal and creative intelligence), and 9th (higher study).

children.label: Children
children.intro: Children and creative progeny themes center on the 5th house and Jupiter, with Moon showing nurturing capacity.

home.label: Home & Family
home.intro: Home, mother, and emotional roots are the 4th house and Moon; 2nd adds family resources and speech at home.

spirituality.label: Spirituality & Inner Life
spirituality.intro: Dharma and inner life come from the 9th (faith), 12th (liberation), 8th (occult depth), Jupiter, and Ketu.

foreign.label: Foreign Travel & Settling Abroad
foreign.intro: Foreign connections often involve the 12th/9th houses and Rahu; 7th/3rd can add travel through partnership or short trips that expand.

father.label: Father & Authority
father.intro: Father and guiding authority are classically linked to the 9th house and Sun, with 10th showing public/authority impact.

mother.label: Mother & Emotional Care
mother.intro: Mother and emotional nurturing are primarily the Moon and the 4th house.
